# Labeled routing fixture for scripts/benchmark_laya.py — TSV, one query per line:
#
#   query <TAB> expected_strategy <TAB> expected_domain
#
# Use "-" for a field that should not be scored.  Labels are deliberately
# conservative: only queries whose intended route is unambiguous are listed, so a
# disagreement is evidence about the model rather than about the labelling.
# Strategies: direct_cmd | database_search | graph_lightrag | complex_llm
# Domains:    raspberry_pi | automotive | general
#
# The traffic this router actually serves is Russian, so Russian queries dominate.

# ── raspberry_pi ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Подойдёт ли Argon ONE V3 для Pi 5 с двумя SSD?	graph_lightrag	raspberry_pi
Что известно про micro-HDMI на Pi 5?	graph_lightrag	raspberry_pi
Сколько ОЗУ у Raspberry Pi 5 в старшей версии?	graph_lightrag	raspberry_pi
Как настроить GPIO на Raspberry Pi?	graph_lightrag	raspberry_pi
